qs.q: Which atomic components particularly govern the geometric constraints and spatial arrangement of the tertiary structure of DNA?
qs.e: The tertiary structure of DNA is governed by the geometric constraints of carbon, hydrogen, and phosphorus. Other elements like nitrogen and oxygen form the bases and backbones, but are not listed as governing these specific spatial arrangements.
